claim_level: finite declared constraints only; never complete physical admissibility
enforced_in_initial_synthetic_model: Support H(x,xi,t)=0 for |x|>1 and endpoint envelope at x=+/-1.
Time-reversal/even-xi dependence where the chosen unpolarized H representation requires it; Sigma and T odd in x and Hg even in x under the baseline Hplus/Hg conventions.

Free-coefficient polynomiality for even spins N=2,4,6,8 on 41 reference-scale moment nodes equally spaced over the broad closed xi interval [0.02,0.98]. Retain every allowed coefficient free; 80 strictly disjoint diagnostic xi nodes, held-out N=10,12 and 96-versus-48 integration refinement are finite checks, not global proof.
D-term slots remain allowed; no mandatory fixed double-distribution profile and no interpretation of symbolic sparsity as true coefficient zeros.
not_enforced_without_external_input: Forward PDFs and flavor-resolved quark/antiquark limits at matched Q and MSbar scheme; the electromagnetic CFF does not identify d versus s or all valence directions.
Flavor-separated Dirac form factors and physical normalization for valence Hq integrals. The Dirac sum rule integrates Hq on -1<=x<=1 (valence); it does not fix the zeroth moment of odd Hq_plus.

Positivity bounds for nucleon H and E require both relevant helicity-flip GPD E and matched forward PDFs, momentum fractions, and physical t. E is not set to zero by default. No such bound is imposed blindly on Sigma,T,Hg.
Physical-region inequality t<=t_min(xi) with target mass and exact external kinematics. Synthetic fixed t=0 at xi>0 is an analytic benchmark, not a physical proton point.
Dispersion/subtraction and impact-parameter bounds need their own assumptions and valid domains; neither is certified by finite polynomiality tests.
nlo_prior_policy: A pointwise positive LO-style GPD/PDF prior is scheme- and scale-sensitive; at NLO no general positivity-preservation claim is made. If a positivity-inspired prior is later proposed, specify matched MSbar scale, all required flavor/E inputs and transformation, test bias/coverage, and obtain separate review.

polynomiality_domain.diagnostic_xi: 80 interlaced midpoints xi_i=0.02+0.96*(i+0.5)/80, i=0,...,79; no overlap with fit nodes
polynomiality_domain.allowed_powers: all even xi powers 0,2,...,N for each channel and spin
polynomiality_domain.qualification: These are reference-scale x-moment integration nodes, not additional CFF observations. If broad-domain enforcement is numerically difficult, stop for review rather than shrinking the domain.

tests_later: Parity and support on independent grids
Polynomial moment residuals on fit and held-out spins/xi values with numerical-refinement audit
Nonempty and violated examples for any added external constraint
No claim of complete physical admissibility from these checks
